module: Loads and saves the drift spots of free roaming. Scans /levels/<level>/driftSpots/ looking for spot.driftSpot.json, builds a spots table keyed by id (level/folder) with their UI info, preview, saved scores and objectives, hides the marker objects of the scene, and writes the modified scores. Also loads the cascade zones (stuntZones) from a JSON file.
notes: Freeroam save: settings/cloud/driftSpots/<spotId>.json; career save: <profile>/career/driftSpots/<spotId>.json (written by onSaveCurrentProfile, only for spots marked _dirty).
The spotsById cache is built lazily by getDriftSpotsById; clearCache or onCareerActive empty it to force a reload.
Each loaded spot has the fields: id, spatialInfo, racePath, bounds, level, info (with preview and name), saveData {scores, objectivesCompleted}, unlocked=true.
The scores in saveData.scores are sorted by descending score at load.
The objects listed in spatialInfo.lines[].markerObjects are hidden (setHidden(true)) as soon as loaded; a warning is logged if an object cannot be found.
The onAfterDriftSpotsLoaded(spotsById) hook is only emitted in active career.

clearCache.desc: Empties the spots cache; the next call to getDriftSpotsById will re-read everything from disk.

onCareerActive.desc: Hook: called when career is activated, empties the spots cache.

onSaveCurrentProfile.desc: Hook: called when saving the career profile; writes to <currentSavePath>/career/driftSpots/ all the spots marked _dirty.

currentSavePath.desc: Save folder of the current profile.

saveDriftSpotsScoresForSpotById.desc: Marks the spot as modified (_dirty). Outside career, immediately writes its scores file in settings/cloud/driftSpots/; in career, the write is deferred to onSaveCurrentProfile.

getDriftSpotById.desc: Returns the data of a spot, or nil if it does not exist in the current level.

returns.desc: Spot data (id, spatialInfo, racePath, bounds, level, info, saveData, unlocked).

getDriftSpotsById.desc: Returns (building it if needed) the table of all the drift spots of the current level, keyed by id. Uses the career save folder if career is active, otherwise settings/cloud/driftSpots/.

getPreviewWithFallback.desc: Looks for preview.jpg, preview.png or preview.jpeg in the given folder; otherwise returns /ui/images/noPreview.jpg.

loadAndSanitizeDriftFreeroamSpotsCurrMap.desc: Returns the list (array) of the spots whose level is the current level.

loadDriftData.desc: Reads a drift data JSON file, converts pos/rot/scl of each stuntZone to vec3/quat, then calls gameplay_drift_stuntZones.setStuntZones(json.stuntZones). Logs an error and returns if the file is absent.

fileName.desc: Path of the JSON file; does nothing if nil.
